metadata.title: Connect Devices
metadata.description: Share your fitness tracker or smartphone app with us.

options.title: TASK: Connect my device(s)
options.description:
Click on the connect button for your device.

The study team will collect activity, sleep, and health data from your wearable devices or smartphone apps. This data will be collected securely and linked with your existing GLAD Study data.

eligibility.title: Who Can Take Part
eligibility.description: We can only accept people onto our study if they answer Yes to the following questions.

items.description: Are you over 16 years of age?
Do you live in the United Kingdom?
Are you part of the existing GLAD Study?

consent.title: Consent
consent.description:
Before you can take part in this wearable data extension of the GLAD Study, we need your consent to share data from your wearable devices or smartphone apps (such as activity, sleep, and heart rate data) alongside your existing GLAD Study participation.
We also need you to create an account, using an email and password, so you can log back into the GLAD Wearables Study portal. You may want to do this to update your personal information or if you decide to leave the study.
Your data will be managed by the GLAD research team and will not be shared with any other parties. You can find out more information about the way we use personal information, and the rights individuals have to control and manage their data in our [privacy policy](https://gladstudy.org.uk/privacy).

requiredItems.description: I confirm that I have read the attached information sheet for the GLAD Study and have had the opportunity to consider the information and ask questions and had these answered satisfactorily.

I understand that my participation in the study is voluntary and that I am free to withdraw at any time without giving a reason and without detriment to myself. I understand that it will not be possible to remove my data from the project once it has been anonymised and forms part of the data set.

I agree to take part on this basis.

I understand my involvement in this wearable data extension of the GLAD Study involves:
- Sharing data from my wearable devices or smartphone apps (such as Fitbit, Apple Watch, Garmin, or health apps) including activity, sleep, and heart rate metrics
- Allowing the GLAD team to analyse my wearable data alongside my existing GLAD Study questionnaire responses to understand how everyday wearable data relates to mental health

I give permission for the GLAD team to access and collect data from my wearable devices or smartphone apps. This includes physical activity data, sleep patterns, heart rate, and other health metrics that may be relevant to understanding how everyday wearable data relates to mental health.
I give permission for the GLAD team to link my wearable device data with my existing GLAD Study questionnaire responses and other data already collected as part of the GLAD Study.
I give permission for the GLAD team to link my wearable device data with my existing GLAD Study data to investigate how everyday wearable data (sleep, activity, heart rate) relates to mental health.

I understand that the data linkage involves combining my wearable device data with my existing GLAD Study data to form a complete research dataset. I give permission for my data to be linked and analysed together.

I give permission for the GLAD team to work with researchers at King's College London and partner institutions to analyse my linked data to answer the study's research questions about how everyday wearable data relates to mental health.
I agree that any data collected may be included in anonymous form in **publications, academic theses, dissertations, or conference presentations.**

I understand that data collected during the study may be looked at by individuals from King's College London, the NIHR Mental Health BioResource, or regulatory authorities, where it is relevant to my taking part in this research. I give permission for these individuals to have access to my data.
I agree to take part in this study.

optionalItems.description:
I agree my questionnaire data and wearable device data, being held at King's College London, can be used by other researchers to answer research questions over and above those for the GLAD study.

I agree on the basis that only pseudonymised data will be shared and where there are data protection measures in place to ensure the confidentiality of the data.
I agree that the researchers may contact me in future about other mental health research projects that I might be eligible for.
I agree that the researchers may retain my contact details in order to provide me with a summary of the findings for this study.

consent.signatureDescription:
**Data Protection**

**The personal information we collect and use to conduct this research will be processed in accordance with data protection law as explained in the Participant Information Sheet and the [Privacy Notice for Research Participants](https://gladstudy.org.uk/privacy).**

By signing this consent form, I declare that I have provided accurate identity details (full name and electronic signature).
